title: Catalog cross-link pass: wiring foundations / quiet money / data brokers / Gulf capital into the surveillance, immigration, adtech, AI-infra, and digital-ID core
source: Public record: ICE/CBP procurement (LexisNexis Risk Solutions contract; broker-data purchases); FTC/Congress data-broker reporting; adtech identity-resolution docs; G42/MGX datacenter build-outs; Worldcoin (Sam Altman) filings; Koch-funded academic centers. Catalog cross-link layer (#209). Structural overlay; edges graded. Purpose: connect the new catalog NODES to the existing thematic blocks so the map is a web, not islands.

edges.notes: LexisNexis Risk Solutions holds a multi-year ICE contract (~$22M) supplying bulk personal + location data used for enforcement/location of individuals - the marquee data-broker-to-deportation pipeline (fact).

ICE (and other agencies) purchase commercial location/utility/vehicle data from brokers to sidestep warrant requirements - the documented 'buy what you can't lawfully collect' pattern (fact; legality contested).
CBP similarly buys broker location data (e.g. Venntel/Babel Street lineage) for border + interior tracking (fact; oversight contested).

Palantir's case-management platforms fuse government records WITH commercial + broker data into unified person-profiles - the analytic layer atop the broker feeds (fact of capability; specific feeds vary).
LiveRamp onboards offline/CRM identities into Meta's ad platform (clean rooms / matched audiences) - the identity-resolution bridge between broker data and walled-garden targeting (fact).
Same identity-onboarding into Google's ad stack - LiveRamp/Acxiom as the connective tissue of surveillance advertising (fact).
Acxiom's consumer attributes have long fed platform ad-targeting (Facebook's 'Partner Categories' used Acxiom until 2018) - the historical broker->platform link (fact).

Location/foot-traffic data of the SafeGraph type feeds analytic platforms (Foundry/Gotham) + government buyers - wiring the location-broker node to the surveillance-analytics core (fact of category; specific deals vary).

The Koch network funds the Mercatus Center at George Mason University - the marquee case of donor-funded academic policy infrastructure (deregulation/free-market research) - wiring the quiet-money layer to academia (fact).
Mercatus supplies free-market/deregulation policy analysis + personnel into federal policymaking - the academia-to-policy pipeline funded by quiet money (fact of role; influence graded).
G42 builds massive AI datacenters (UAE + abroad; the Stargate-UAE effort) - wiring Gulf quiet capital to the physical AI-infrastructure core (fact).
G42 is central to the UAE Stargate/compute build-out (with OpenAI/Oracle/Nvidia/SoftBank orbit) - the Gulf leg of the AI-datacenter bandwagon (fact).
MGX (Tahnoon/Mubadala/G42) finances AI-datacenter + compute at scale - sovereign capital into the buildout (fact).
Tether (USDT) is the largest stablecoin - anchoring the quiet-controller node to the stablecoin/Treasury-rail thread (fact).
Sam Altman co-founded Worldcoin (Tools for Humanity) - the iris-biometric 'proof-of-personhood' digital-ID + crypto project; wires the AI-lab elite to the digital-ID/biometrics thread (fact).

Worldcoin's Orb-scanned iris 'World ID' is a privatized global biometric identity - the most aggressive private digital-ID play; banned/investigated in several jurisdictions (fact of product; privacy-contested).

ID2020 (foundation-led digital identity 'for all') and Worldcoin (private biometric ID) are the nonprofit + for-profit poles of the same digital-identity push - wiring the foundations block to the biometrics thread (fact of category).
Anthropic is the AI lab most identified with the longtermist/EA ('L'/'E') strands of the TESCREAL cluster - completing the ideology->frontier-lab wiring (interpretation; critics' framing).
